subplayer.release_notes: v1.3.4: Up/Down arrow keys now step through the sample list — the list scrolls to keep the selected sample visible and each step previews the sample just like clicking it.

lock.release_notes: First release. Automatic vocal alignment: always listening, captures on vocal, aligns dubs to the lead. Never mutes your live vocal.

looplab.release_notes: v1.5.1: New 6th category tab — VocalLoops ("Vocal Loops"). Folder-based like the other 5 categories; per-category counts, composes with search/key/used filters. Everything else identical to v1.5.0.

hub.release_notes: v1.0.2: Fixed the crash on launch for the owner-stats path (SIGABRT in the stats worker teardown — the result callback no longer destroys its own worker thread). Downloaded plugin files now also land in ~/Documents/KTTB Plugins/<name>/ so you can move them wherever you like.
